data.long_meaning: Ashmika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Ashmaka tree, which is believed to symbolize life and longevity. historical_references.reference: Ashmika was a celebrated poetess and musician in ancient India, renowned for her exquisite compositions in Sanskrit and Telugu languages. She is believed to have lived during the 6th and 7th centuries CE in the southern Indian region of Andhra Pradesh, and is considered an important figure in the Bhakti movement which emphasized devotion to deities through music and literature.

Another reference suggests that Ashmika was a queen of the Vakataka dynasty in the Deccan region of India around the 5th century CE. She is known for her contributions to the construction of numerous temples and her patronage of scholars and artists during her reign.
